stochasticDiagnostics.globalNote: Empirical first-pass group diagnostic (first IAUE iteration, not unbiased VCE): s_k² = Ω_k/R_k with R_k = tr(P_k·Qvv_k). Weighted control-constraint rows are excluded by reporting policy (separate datum semantics), so group quadforms sum below the global vtpv by the constraint contribution. E[Ω_k] mixes variance components across groups through parameter coupling; simultaneous multi-group VCE is deferred.
